list.label: MAC
list.description: Fragment of a MAC address, e.g. 00:24:97

panels.title: CPU (1m)
panels.description: Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: Failed fans
panels.description: Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: Power supplies
panels.description: A switch without a redundant power supply connected usually reports the second PSU as failed. Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: MAC addresses
panels.description: Entries in the MAC address table (fdb job, scraped every minute).

panels.title: Half-duplex ports

targets.expr: sum(dlink_interface_duplex{instance="$instance",duplex="half"} and on(instance, ifindex) dlink_interface_oper_up == 1) or vector(0)

panels.description: Ports that are up in half duplex: usually a duplex mismatch with the connected device.

panels.title: Errors (1h)
panels.description: Inbound + outbound errors on all ports over the last hour.

panels.title: Ports

targets.expr: max by (ifindex, port, ifname, description) (dlink_interface_duplex{instance="$instance",duplex="full"}) * 2 + max by (ifindex, port, ifname, description) (dlink_interface_duplex{instance="$instance",duplex="half"})

panels.description: In/Out are 5-minute averages; MACs comes from the fdb job.

panels.title: Traffic (bits/s)
panels.description: Ports that are up. Outbound traffic is drawn below zero.

panels.title: Multicast packets/s
panels.description: A broadcast/multicast storm shows up here first.

panels.title: Broadcast packets/s
panels.description: A broadcast/multicast storm shows up here first.

panels.title: Ethernet errors by type
panels.description: EtherLike-MIB: FCS, alignment, collisions, symbol errors... Late collisions point to a duplex mismatch.

panels.title: Frame sizes (RMON, packets/s)
panels.description: All ports, by frame size. Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: Rx power
panels.description: Dashed lines are the module's low-alarm thresholds. Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: Tx power
panels.description: Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: MAC addresses
panels.description: Filter with the Port, VLAN and MAC variables at the top (MAC accepts a fragment, colon-separated).

panels.title: MACs per port
panels.description: Many MACs on an access port: an unmanaged switch or a loop.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: DGS-3120 firmware reports DRAM as ~99% used at all times; watch the trend, not the level. Smart switches such as the DGS-1500 do not report this over SNMP.
